Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Return solution.go in package solution.
Required API: func AllocateFixed(total int, weights []int) ([]int, bool)
Behavior: total and weights must be integers in 0..10,000,000; the weight sum must not exceed 10,000,000. Reject empty/all-zero weights or any derived product above 100,000,000,000,000. Allocate by largest remainder: floors first, then leftovers by descending remainder and ascending index.
Visible example: total 7 and weights [1,1,1] allocates [3,2,2].

Buggy source to repair:

package solution
func AllocateFixed(int,[]int)([]int,bool){return nil,false}

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
